## Engineering references

The [complete technical reference list](docs/references.qmd) links course materials and manufacturer documentation for the STM32L432KC, UPduino, DRV5055, MCP3204, INA240, and UCC27511. Candidate part information is documented in the [hardware guide](docs/hardware.qmd).

Project claims on this site derive from the repository’s design, hardware, protocol, and verification notes. Quantitative implementation results are attributed to the [October 15, 2026 record](docs/verification.qmd).

## Portfolio structure

[Carlos and Maynor’s E155 project site](https://maynorb.github.io/E155ProjectSite/) provided the page-organization reference: documentation, MCU design, FPGA design, results, AI use, and acknowledgements. Its [public Quarto source](https://github.com/MaynorB/E155ProjectSite) was reviewed when the hosted site could not be fetched. Its portable DJ project content, measurements, and media are not reused here.

## Design references

| Reference | Application in this site |
|---|---|
| [Awwwards](https://www.awwwards.com/) and its [portfolio inspiration](https://www.awwwards.com/inspiration/scroll-portfolio) | Editorial hierarchy, generous spacing, and project-specific art direction |
| [Impeccable](https://impeccable.style/#downloads) | Clear hierarchy, readable text, restrained effects, and concrete labels |
| User-supplied apple-design skill | System typography, translucent navigation, immediate feedback, accessibility preferences |
| [Magic UI components](https://magicui.design/docs/components) | Connected-system presentation and modular chapter navigation |
| [Material UI tabs](https://mui.com/material-ui/react-tabs/) | Familiar tab semantics, selected states, and keyboard interaction |
| [Untitled UI components](https://www.untitledui.com/react/components) | Documentation navigation, disclosure rows, and consistent spacing |

These are design and interaction references. The site implements its own lightweight components for Quarto; no paid assets or React library code are included.

## Illustration and acknowledgements

The magnetic-field illustration and favicon were created for this website as SVG assets. The illustration describes the concept and does not represent measured fields or an assembled prototype.

Named acknowledgements and team contribution details are pending confirmation from the project team. [See the project information](about.qmd) and [AI-use disclosure](ai.qmd).
